heroTitleLine2: and take the results with you as CSV or ICS
heroSubtitle: Pick candidate dates and share a link. {symbols} answers are tallied automatically, and the final date goes straight to Excel (CSV) or to Google Calendar and Outlook (ICS). For one-on-one meetings, you can also publish your open slots on a 1-on-1 booking page and let guests choose.
demoAlt: Preview of the response table: three participants answered for three candidate dates, and the easiest date has a Best badge
modeSelectorTitle: Pick the right tool for the job
modeSelectorLead: Use group scheduling to find a time that works for many people, or a 1-on-1 booking page for interviews and client meetings. Both are free and need no sign-up.
modeGroupDesc: Propose candidate dates and let everyone answer with {symbols}. Collect everyone's availability and find the best time.
modeGroupPoint1: Answers are tallied and the best date is highlighted
modeGroupPoint2: Export results as CSV (Excel) or ICS
modeGroupPoint3: Add dates, close responses or finalize at any time
modeGroupNote: Great for meetups, parties and team meetings
mode1on1Desc: Publish your open slots. When a guest picks one, the booking is confirmed.
mode1on1Point1: Guests just pick a slot, no tallying needed
mode1on1Point2: Bookings and cancellations are sent by e-mail
mode1on1Point3: No login. Just verify your e-mail address to publish
mode1on1Note: Great for interviews, sales calls and lessons
featuresLead: Don't stop at gathering availability: put the results to work in Excel and your calendar.
feature1Desc: Neither organizers nor participants need an account. Share a link and anyone can respond right away.
feature2Desc: Download every {symbols} answer, comment and per-date total as CSV. It opens directly in Excel.
feature3Desc: Add the final date to Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar in one click.
feature4Desc: Add or remove dates, rename the event, change the deadline, close or reopen responses, and finalize whenever you like.
feature5Desc: Answers are scored automatically and the date that works for the most people gets a Best badge.
feature6Desc: A modern interface optimized for phones. Add it to your home screen and use it like an app.
advancedFeaturesDesc: Every core feature works without logging in. Create an account to connect your calendar and see a list of the events you created.
advFeature1Desc: Log in and connect your calendar to add finalized dates to it automatically.
advFeature2Desc: When a date is finalized, a Google Meet or Microsoft Teams link is created and shown on the event page and in the ICS file.
advFeature3Desc: Get an e-mail for each new response. Set a deadline and reminders help make sure nobody forgets to answer.
advFeature4Desc: Available in 8 languages including English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Besides light and dark, there is a cute theme that shows answers as emoji faces.
stepsLead: Even first-timers can create an event in about a minute.
step1Desc: Enter an event name and your name, then tap candidate dates on the calendar.
step2Desc: Send the link to participants with the tools you already use: chat, e-mail, Slack and more.
step3Desc: Answers are tallied automatically. Confirm the best date, finalize it and add it to your calendar.
steps1on1Note: For a 1-on-1 booking page, just add your open slots and share the link. When a guest picks a slot, the booking is confirmed and both of you get an e-mail.
useCasesLead: Coordinate with anyone through a single link, even people outside your group chat.
useCase1Desc: Manage attendance for large, open groups.
useCase1Item1: Study groups, workshops and lightning talks
useCase2Item1: No need to ask clients to sign up
useCase2Item2: Send the final date to your calendar via ICS
useCase3Desc: Regular meetings and parties, including people outside your company.
useCase3Item3: Finalize in one click from the tally
useCase4Desc: Take one-on-one bookings with a 1-on-1 booking page.
useCase4Item2: Publish open slots and let guests choose
useCase4Item3: Get bookings and cancellations by e-mail
ctaTitle: Start scheduling with just a link
ctaDesc: No sign-up, completely free. Ready in one minute.
